scope: Read-only disposition of the protected current-Aero 2x preconfiguration diagnostic only. It is a diagnostic adverse, not a source, fixture or release pass.

observations.early_order: The added aaa observer is loaded ahead of MIR and emits both early-new-mod-on-init and early-on-configuration-changed frames before MIR's on_configuration_changed refusal.
observations.frames: Both frames show all four force mining_drill_productivity_bonus, manual_mining_speed_modifier and worker_robots_speed_modifier values at zero. They simultaneously retain the protected worker facts: player bonus4/current worker-robots-storage-4/progress0.375 and queued/detached/unpaid current/progress frames.
observations.later_adverse: MIR then correctly refuses the changed selection because the added diagnostic mod violates the protected source's unchanged-mod-selection admission. The one-process exit1 is retained; it is expected diagnostic containment and not a gameplay or release result.
observations.source_api: Current MIR source has no direct assignment to the three observed modifier fields and no reset_technology_effects call. It does write LuaTechnology.level during the transfer. Official Factorio2.1 API says reset_technology_effects loses custom force changes and that a level write is research-equivalent/enables the technology.

disposition.reason: The scripted values are already zero before MIR executes the transfer. The original post-transfer zero observation therefore cannot be attributed to MIR and must not be converted into an expected-zero success.
disposition.source_change: No source change is justified by this diagnostic.
disposition.fixture_replacement: Use a test-owned finite foreign technology with three real native effects .17/.23/.31, researched during separately labelled scripted setup. The next fixture must record its non-MIR creator/prototype history, researched/level state, effect vector and all-force bonus map before and after the unchanged-selection valid upgrade. Direct LuaForce modifier assignment alone is not an ownership witness.
disposition.release_effect: Preserve the original multiplier r02 adverse. Current 2x/4x work/save/cold qualification remains required; no beta/release verdict follows.
